summary: Personalized AI model comparison transformed for Priyanshu's actual YouTube content creator workflow. Maps generic benchmarks to his real tasks: scriptwriting, ElevenLabs voiceover prep, Remotion code generation, competitor research, thumbnail generation, vidIQ integration, Hindi content for Nishchay Stories, and ADHD-friendly workflow support. Includes custom 'Priyanshu Benchmarks' scoring each model on his actual daily tasks instead of abstract coding/science benchmarks. Covers Opus 4.6, Opus 5, Gemini 3.1 Pro (High), Nemotron 3 Ultra, and OX Alpha.
